intro.title: A consultancy for decisions that matter
paragraphs: Organisations come to us at moments of decision: before a programme starts, before an investment is made, before a reform is adopted, or when a message has to reach people who are hard to reach. Our role is to give them a clear view of where they stand and practical options for what to do next.

We combine research and analysis with the work that turns findings into action: convening stakeholders, communicating clearly, strengthening institutions and building skills. Clients can use one service or bring several together into a single programme of support.

items.title: Global perspective
items.text: International standards and methods applied to every assignment, so findings stand up to scrutiny from donors, investors and partners anywhere.

items.title: Cultural depth
items.text: Understanding the languages, institutions and histories that shape how decisions are made on the ground. Good advice depends on knowing the setting it will be used in.

items.title: Strategic thinking
items.text: Every finding has a use and every recommendation has a reason. We connect evidence to the decision it is meant to inform.

items.title: Integrity
items.text: We report what the evidence shows, including what clients may not want to hear.

items.title: Rigour
items.text: Sound methods, checked data and conclusions that can be traced back to their source.

items.title: Respect
items.text: For participants, for local knowledge and for the institutions we work alongside.

items.title: Partnership
items.text: We work with clients, not around them, and leave capability behind.

items.title: Clarity
items.text: Plain language, clear recommendations and no unnecessary complexity.

paragraphs: Our visual identity draws on girih, the strapwork geometry found in the tilework of Herat’s historic architecture. Girih patterns are built with compass and straightedge from a few simple rules, yet they produce figures of great complexity and balance.

We see the same idea in good consulting: separate disciplines, drawn with care, that fit together into one coherent piece of work. The pointed arch that frames our images and pages comes from the same architectural tradition.

closing.title: Work with us
closing.text: Tell us about the decision in front of you. We will tell you honestly whether and how we can help.
